Name: Global Config Settings Rewrite
Author: FawazT
Description:
[size=3]This mod is a rewrite of [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9340]Global Config Settings[/url][/size][size=6]

Installation[/size]
[list=1]
[*]Install [url=https://smapi.io]SMAPI[/url]﻿[/*]
[*]Download focustense's [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/28870]StardewUI[/url]﻿ mod[/*]
[*]Download the mod from the files tab[/*]
[/list]
[size=6]Features[/size]

[list]
[*]Apply settings to all saves[/*]
[*]Whitelist and blacklist saves[/*]
[/list]
[size=6]Configuring Settings[/size][size=5]

GMCM[/size]
[size=3]If you have GMCM installed, you can open the GMCM menu and open the menu from there.[/size][size=5]

Iconic Framework[/size]
[size=3]If you have Iconic Framework installed, you can open the menu from the button located next to the toolbar.[/size][size=5]

Star Control[/size]
[size=3]If you have Star Control installed, you can open the menu using the shortcut.[/size][size=5]

Console[/size]
[size=3]You can use the command [b]gcsr_open[/b] to open the menu[/size][size=5].

config.json[/size]
[size=3]You can edit the config.json file to change the settings, [/size][size=5][url=https://github.com/FawazTakahji/GlobalConfigSettingsRewrite?tab=readme-ov-file#values][size=3]here is a list of available values[/size][/url][/size][size=3].[/size]
